summary: Use an Icon Button for a frequent, well-known action where an icon alone is clear, such as add, share, or close.

anatomy.holds: A circle whose size comes from the Button / Size mode.

from.quote: Circle whose size comes from the Button / Size mode.

anatomy.holds: One registry icon (iconName) that names the action.

from.quote: One registry icon that names the action.

placementAdvice.text: The button is a fixed square: it never stretches with its container.

from.quote: The button never stretches with its container.

placementAdvice.text: In the guide's statement-card example, Icon Buttons sit together at the end of a row; the strongest one is the main action, and the screen handles each press.

from.quote: Icon Buttons sit together at the end of a row. The strongest one is the main action; the screen handles each press.

configuration.text: Use Emphasis High for the main action in a group and Medium or Low for the rest.

from.quote: Use High for the main action in a group and Medium or Low for the rest.

configuration.text: Emphasis sets how loud the button is: it steps the fill from solid gold (High) to tint (Medium) to none (Low).

from.quote: Emphasis steps the fill from solid gold to tint to none.

configuration.text: Do not make every action loud: three High buttons compete for attention.

from.quote: Three High buttons compete for attention.

configuration.text: AppearanceBrand picks the brand colour family; it changes the colour family, not the importance.

from.quote: Appearance changes the colour family, not the importance.

configuration.text: Button / Size gives two sizes: Medium is 40 px and Small is 26 px in the installed package (Figma draws Medium at 42 px); XS renders the same as Small.

from.quote: Medium is 40 px and Small is 26 px in the installed package; Figma draws Medium at 42 px. XS renders the same as Small.

configuration.text: Keep sizes consistent in a row: one size reads as one group.

from.quote: One size reads as one group.

configuration.text: Do not mix sizes in one row: mixed sizes look like different kinds of action.

from.quote: Mixed sizes look like different kinds of action.

configuration.text: A toggle (isToggle) swaps between two icons, inactiveIcon and activeIcon; its On state (isActive) turns into a white circle with a black icon.

from.quote: A toggle swaps between two icons, and its On state turns into a white circle with a black icon.

rules.text: One familiar icon, one clear action, and a label for people who cannot see it.

from.quote: One familiar icon, one clear action, and a label for people who cannot see it.

rules.text: Use icons with one common meaning.

from.quote: Use icons with one common meaning and give each button a label that says the action, such as “Share statement”, not the icon’s name.

rules.text: Give each button a label that says the action, such as “Share statement”, not the icon's name.

from.quote: Use icons with one common meaning and give each button a label that says the action, such as “Share statement”, not the icon’s name.

rules.text: Use a familiar icon: a download arrow says what happens.

from.quote: A download arrow says what happens.

rules.text: Do not use an unclear icon: a card icon does not say it downloads a statement.

from.quote: A card icon does not say it downloads a statement.

  <IconButton iconName="ic_filter" accessibilityLabel="Filter transactions" onPress={() => {}} modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light', Emphasis: 'Medium' }} />
  <IconButton iconName="ic_download" accessibilityLabel="Download statement" onPress={() => {}} modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light', Emphasis: 'High' }} />
</HStack>

props.name: iconName
props.description: Built-in icon name from the registry (default state).

props.name: source
props.description: Unified fallback source for the default state, used when `iconName` is missing or not in the registry. Accepts a remote URI, an inline SVG XML string, a `require()` asset, an SVG React component, or a React element. The result is tinted with the button's mode-resolved icon color so it follows design tokens just like a built-in icon. See {@link UnifiedSource}.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Default false, from the component source.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Without it, the name is derived from the icon (ic_flash gives “Flash”); a toggle keeps the same derived name in both states.

props.name: isToggle
props.description: Whether the button behaves as a toggle button. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: activeIcon
props.description: Icon to display when isToggle is true and isActive is true.

props.name: activeSource
props.description: Unified fallback source for the active state. Used when `activeIcon` is missing or not in the registry (and only when `isToggle` is true and `isActive` is true). Falls back to the default `source` if not provided. See {@link UnifiedSource}.

props.name: inactiveIcon
props.description: Icon to display when isToggle is true and isActive is false.

props.name: inactiveSource
props.description: Unified fallback source for the inactive state. Used when `inactiveIcon` is missing or not in the registry (and only when `isToggle` is true and `isActive` is false). Falls back to the default `source` if not provided. See {@link UnifiedSource}.

props.name: isActive
props.description: On a toggle, the On state reads the toggle tokens (white fill in Light), and aria-pressed follows isActive on the web. Declared: Whether the toggle button is in active state (only used when isToggle is true) Default false, from the component source.

props.name: webAccessibilityProps
props.description: Web-specific accessibility props (only used on web platform)

props.name: loading
props.description: Explicit per-instance loading override. When `true`, renders a same-size pill-shaped skeleton instead of the button. Defaults to inheriting from the surrounding `<SkeletonGroup>`.

props.name: ...SafePressableProps
props.description: Inherited React Native props the component also accepts. They are not part of the design contract and no guide documents them.

modes.name: AppearanceBrand
modes.description: A token collection IconButton reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Button / Size
modes.description: M renders 40 × 40 (Figma 42 × 42); S and XS both render 26 × 26 with a 16 px icon. Declared: A token collection IconButton reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.
